env HOME=$WORK/home

exec patrolbot config view
cmp stdout basic-home-config.golden

# Env variables can override config.yaml.
env PATROLBOT_WIKI=zwfr
exec patrolbot config view
cmp stdout override-wiki-env.golden
env PATROLBOT_WIKI=

# Flags can override config.yaml and env variables.
env PATROLBOT_WIKI=zwfr
exec patrolbot --wiki wikipedia config view
cmp stdout override-wiki-flag.golden
env PATROLBOT_WIKI=

# Env variables can override nested properties.
env PATROLBOT_WIKIS_ZWEN_PASSWORD=password
exec patrolbot config view
cmp stdout override-env-nested.golden
env PATROLBOT_WIKIS_ZWEN_PASSWORD=

# config.yaml in current directory has precedence over home config.
# Config files are not merged - only the highest precedence file is considered.
cp wikipedia.yaml config.yaml
exec patrolbot config view
cmp stdout override-curdir.golden
rm config.yaml

# config file specified via flag has precedence over ./config.yaml and $HOME/.patrolbot/config.yaml
cp wikipedia.yaml config.yaml
exec patrolbot config view --config dunepedia.yaml
cmp stdout override-config-flag.golden
rm config.yaml

# -c is a shorthand for --config
exec patrolbot config view -c dunepedia.yaml
cmp stdout override-config-flag.golden

-- home/.patrolbot/config.yaml --
wiki: zwen
wikis:
  zwen:
    url: https://zeldawiki.wiki
    username: PhantomCaleb@Patrolbot
    password: ""

  zwfr:
    url: https://fr.zeldawiki.wiki
    username: FantômeCaleb@Patrolbot
    password: ""

-- wikipedia.yaml --
wiki: wikipedia

-- dunepedia.yaml --
wiki: dunepedia

-- basic-home-config.golden --
